80129205-6ea6-49a4-8173-7dcf3b0b0e35.description:
CSV-only fallback works but must label output as estimated. No dependency on Cursor Admin API or OpenTelemetry — CSV heuristic mapper is the only planned approach for now.

1. Add event-to-session attribution table. Keep raw CSV rows unchanged.
   usage_event_id -> composer_id | confidence | method | candidate_count

2. Build candidates per CSV row.
   - Session active during event time: created_at <= event_at <= last_updated_at + 5m
   - Exact model match: bonus. Weak signal: 1,081/1,242 rows use auto.
   - Transcript activity near event time: strong bonus, if JSONL carries per-message timestamps.
   - Single candidate: assign high confidence.
   - Multiple candidates: fractional allocation, weights sum to 1, mark low confidence.
   - No candidate: leave unassigned.

3. Group CSV rows into activity bursts, UI-only grouping (not a session proxy). 10-minute idle gap -> 145 bursts in current export, largest burst 208 rows. Burst != session.

4. Never overwrite billing totals. Show:
   - Raw Cursor total: exact
   - Attributed-to-project/session total: estimated
   - Unattributed total: exact remainder

Blocker: local adapter (internal/adapter/cursor/adapter.go:90) only has composer createdAt/lastUpdatedAt, no per-bubble timestamps. Time-only matching weak for concurrent sessions.

Explicitly out of scope: Cursor Admin API connector and OpenTelemetry ingest — this app will not depend on Cursor APIs for attribution.
